One evaluated candidate node created and handed off.

## What I did

**Stage 1 — Analysis.** Read the baseline note and traces. The baseline (avg 0.4378) fails mostly on label *form*: 29 of 99 scored LawBench replies were exactly one character away from a charge name the memory itself demonstrates (23 of them a trailing `罪` added, e.g. `[罪名]单位行贿罪<eoa>` vs memorised `单位行贿`), and the leaked `[罪名]…<eoa>` markup is already handled by the evaluator — so the one-character near-miss was the entire loss. USPTO and Symptom2Disease were shown to be genuine content errors (SMILES reasoning; symptom confusion), not answer-space violations.

**Stage 2 — Evolution.** Branch `answer-space-grounding` off `804b98a`, one mechanism: **memory-derived answer-space grounding**.
- New `solver/answer_space.py` derives the answer space from the frozen memory alone (no dataset names, no label lists, no Val/Test labels): strips annotation tags/lead-ins while leaving SMILES atom brackets alone, keeps recurring answer strings, and accepts a separator only when the pieces it splits out are themselves complete memorised answers (`;` reuse 0.32; `、`, `.`, `(` and `)` all 0.00 → rejected).
- `solver/agent.py` wraps the deep agent so the final reply's answer strings are snapped onto a memorised answer only when exactly one lies within one edit; everything else passes through byte-identical.

Pre-run validation on the parent's own predictions predicted LawBench +16 with 0 breakage.

**Result (one run, tree `53597ebc`)** — `{"USPTO": 0.1167, "Symptom2Disease": 0.82, "LawBench": 0.42, "average": 0.4522, "status": "partial"}`, mean 0.4378 → 0.4522.

**Audit.** LawBench: 29 near-misses → 0, 41 → 62 exactly-in-space replies, 17 samples gained vs 3 lost, and 15 of the 17 gains are literally the snap of the parent run's own prediction. USPTO and Symptom2Disease had **0 repair targets in both runs** (no candidate prediction is even a plausible grounding target), so their deltas — including USPTO's drop — are run-to-run solver variance (only 13/60 and 94/100 predictions are byte-identical to the parent run), not this modification. I stated this explicitly in the note rather than claiming the net gain as mechanism-attributable.

Committed as `adaed03` (tree verified equal to the evaluated tree, source clean), note attached under `refs/notes/evolution`.
